subject: MAP: POC environment activation — API keys, org seed, allowlist & peering
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jmills@cardioai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sally Thompson <sally@cardioai.com>
Date: 2026-06-16 09:12 PDT
Subject: MAP kickoff & POC environment questions

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the demo last week. We want to move forward with a 3-week POC focused on throughput and latency for our cardiology OCR pipeline. To get the MAP started, can you confirm what you will need from us to stand up a POC environment? Specifically:

- API keys / scoped credentials (ephemeral vs long-lived)
- Redwood org setup & roles (SAML/SSO later)
- IP allowlist requirements for your hosted endpoints or whether we should do VPC peering
- Typical peering CIDR and timing for a peering window

Target: kickoff next Monday (2026-06-22) and close POC by 2026-07-13. Can your team commit to that cadence?

If possible, please send a one-page MAP and a short checklist we can share with our infra and security teams.

Jordan
Jordan Mills
Head of Platform, CardioAI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <jmills@cardioai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & POC environment questions

Jordan — thanks, excited to partner. High-level MAP and asks below (we'll attach a draft MAP). Proposed ownership: Redwood owns runtime provisioning, CardioAI owns network peering and allowlist. Target dates match our availability.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Week 0 (prep, by 2026-06-21): CardioAI provides peering contact, public ASN (if needed), and a temporary allowlist IP range for testing. Redwood shares MAP_Draft_CardioAI.docx.
- Week 1 (kickoff 2026-06-22): Redwood creates sandbox org seed and two scoped API keys (one long-lived admin token for SRE, one ephemeral key for apps).
- Week 2: Performance ramp, we enable VPC peering (optional) + IP allowlist cutover.
- Week 3 (close by 2026-07-13): Post-POC summary, telemetry handoff, recommendation for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Key asks for your infra/security:
1) Confirm public egress CIDR(s) or request VPC peering (preferred for stable bandwidth).
2) Whitelisted IPs for telemetry callbacks.
3) Procurement timeline for any dedicated capacity (if you want guaranteed throughput).

Attachments: MAP_Draft_CardioAI.docx (draft MAP and checklist). I'll loop in Neha and Marissa to finalize technical steps and peering windows.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16 11:08 PDT
Subject: Internal: CardioAI POC — org seed & key plan

Neha / Marissa — quick internal note: Jordan wants sandbox org + two key types (admin + ephemeral). Can you confirm:

- Preferred ephemeral TTL (I suggest 1 hour for app tests, 24 hours for SRE).
- Org seed: create a placeholder org named cardioai-poc-8421 with SRE role + dev role.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide our peering endpoint, but recommend CardioAI either provide a /28 for testing or request VPC peering. If they choose peering, we'll need their VPC CIDR and peering contact.

Also: create a minimal peering_runbook.md we can share (simple steps + firewall rules + common failure points). Marissa — can you handle the MAP approval once we update the timeline?

Thanks — R
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16 14:22 PDT
Subject: Re: Internal: CardioAI POC — org seed & key plan

Rishi — noted. Technical checklist (to share with CardioAI):

1) API keys
   - Admin key: long-lived, scoped to org-admin; deliver via secure link to SRE.
   - Ephemeral app key: rotate TTL = 1 hour (recommended). Provide sample curl for token exchange.

2) IP allowlist vs peering
   - If allowlist: CardioAI must add these egress IPs: 52.203.112.16/28 (egress), 52.203.112.32 (callback).
   - If peering: request CardioAI VPC CIDR /20 — we will not accept overlapping CIDRs. Provide BGP ASN only if they want routed peering.

3) VPC peering window
   - We can provision peering on weekdays between 09:00–17:00 PT; typical lead time 48–72 hours after receiving peering contact and CIDR.

4) Firewall rules + test plan
   - Allow outbound to 52.203.112.16/28 on 443.
   - Run our sample infer test (attached in peering_runbook.md).

I'll attach peering_runbook.md (short). I'll also include soc2_summary.pdf for security team's request once they ask — it's redacted to control scope.

-Neha
From: Jordan Mills <jmills@cardioai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sally Thompson <sally@cardioai.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@cardioai.com>
Date: 2026-06-17 08:45 PDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & POC environment questions

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our security and procurement teams:

- Can you provide a SOC 2 summary and a short data residency statement (we host in us-west-2 and need to confirm logs/data stay within region)?
- Procurement needs an estimated cost for the 3-week test (hourly token/sample run estimate) and a POC SOW to sign.

We will discuss internally whether to do allowlist or peering; leaning to peering for throughput. If we pick peering, I'll send our VPC CIDR and peering contact today.

Also attaching a short PO template from procurement (we might use it).

Jordan
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <jmills@cardioai.com>, Sally Thompson <sally@cardioai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procure@cardioai.com>
Date: 2026-06-18 16:04 PDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & POC environment questions — confirmation and attachments

Jordan — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and attachments:

- Attached: soc2_summary.pdf (redacted SOC 2 overview), MAP_Final_CardioAI.docx (final MAP with responsibilities and timeline).
- Proposed peering window: 2026-06-24 10:00–12:00 PT (placeholder). Please confirm your peering contact and VPC CIDR (we specifically need non-overlapping CIDR and preferred /20 or /21). Lead time for peering 48–72 hours from receipt of info.
- API keys: we will create admin key and a single ephemeral key for your app on 2026-06-22 and share via secure link to your SRE contact. Ephemeral TTL defaults to 1 hour but can be extended to 24 hours on request.
- Cost estimate: conservative hosted POC estimate attached inside MAP_Final_CardioAI.docx (line items + sample token run). If you want Dedicated capacity quote, we can fast-track pricing.

Next actions for CardioAI:
- Confirm peering vs allowlist and provide CIDR + contact (reply-all)
- Procurement: review MAP_Final_CardioAI.docx and send PO if you want us to reserve capacity.

I'll send the secure admin key link once we have SRE contact.

Best —
Rishi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: soc2_summary.pdf, MAP_Final_CardioAI.docx
